steps.message: ERT_Compatibility only runs on devices that cannot back the full bindless arrays (MoltenVK on A12X-class GPUs), so this script forces the profile on a capable GPU. Without it the compatibility path has no desktop regression at all.

steps.comment: ERT_Compatibility; a capable GPU must not silently keep a normal renderer.
The compatibility profile still commits a real scene; only the render path is reduced.
Frames keep advancing: no stall in acquire/submit/present.
Base-colour geometry over the background clear.
playground is an open scene, so the camera still frames geometry after the move -- the second screenshot is meant to be eyeballed.
Camera drives the pass without tripping a missing resource.
UI must still composite over the scene.
